data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name Berhtari, meaning 'bright, shining'. The name was commonly used among the Germanic tribes and later adopted by the Anglo-Saxons. In the Middle Ages, it became a popular name in England and France. The name Bertie carries the meaning “Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bertie usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
